description: Read or change the settings object of an app. Call with only appId to read. To change, pass set: the keys in it are MERGED into the current settings (objects merge key by key at every depth, arrays and plain values replace, null removes a key). The server itself does not merge: PATCH replaces the whole settings object with what it is sent, so this tool reads the app, merges, and writes the full object back; two writers at the same moment can still overwrite each other, so do not run it in parallel on one app. Settings the server reads: ai (AI actions the app may run: { enabled: true, userDaily?, appDaily?, actions: { "<name>": { instructions, output?: "text"|"json", schema? (a JSON Schema, required for json), inputs?: { "<input>": { maxChars?, required? } }, tier?: "fast"|"smart", maxOutputTokens?, temperature?, audience?: "users"|"server" } } }. The instructions stay on the server: a page runs an action by name with POST /apps/<slug>/api/_ai/v1/run { action, input } and the signed-in user's own token (the app's server may use a key with the "ai" scope). Every run is charged to the owner's usage allowance; 429 AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, AI_USER_DAILY_LIMIT or AI_RATE_LIMIT carry messageHe/message to show. An app without sign-in cannot run AI actions), passwordReset.returnUrls (array of up to 50 URLs the "reset password" email may send a user back to, matched by scheme, host, port and path prefix; needed only for a custom app scheme such as myapp://reset or a domain other than the app's own {slug}.tasklite.dev and its connected custom domains, which are always allowed; http is never accepted), language (the language of the password reset email: a value starting with "he" gives Hebrew, any other value English; left out, the user's own language decides), endUserDeletion.rows ("delete": when an end user deletes their account, the rows they wrote in this app are deleted with it and erased for good 30 days later; left out, the rows stay with the author shown as a deleted account). Other keys are stored as given and returned, and the server does not act on them.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

set.description: Keys to merge into the settings, e.g. { passwordReset: { returnUrls: ["myapp://reset"] } } or { endUserDeletion: { rows: "delete" } }. null removes a key: { language: null }. Omit to read without changing anything

name: configure_app_settings
